userStories.title: RAG: batched full-chunk hydration consumed by the formatter
userStories.description: modules/rag/service.py:855-909 already hydrates full chunk text into candidate['expanded_content'] via one asyncpg query PER candidate, and NOTHING reads it — service.py:544 and :754 read only c['content'] (the 500-char S3 metadata preview written by ingestion/manager.py:1300). Replace the N+1 with ONE batched IN-query over parent chunk ids, and make the retrieval/format path consume the hydrated text so result_formatter.py's 4000-char per-doc budget (:354-356) actually fills. Do not change chunking or S3 writes.

userStories.description: Root cause (1-of-4-workers APScheduler state) is fixed properly in PRD-162. Stopgap so the calendar stops caching empty results: a get_schedule response with scheduler_active=false becomes a thrown error so React Query retries instead of rendering an empty calendar from a 200; add AbortSignal.timeout(15000) and a visible error state with retry button in CalendarTab.
acceptanceCriteria: DONE — useActivitySchedule queryFn (hooks/use-activity-api.ts) now routes the response through new exported scheduleOrThrow(): a scheduler_active=false 200 THROWS (an empty `scheduled` list from a scheduler-less worker is noise, not truth) so React Query (retry:2 already configured) retries another worker instead of caching/rendering an empty calendar. components/__tests__/calendar-schedule-retry.test.ts (5): scheduleOrThrow throws on false, returns data unchanged on true AND on absent (legacy 200); wiring guards assert the queryFn has AbortSignal.timeout(15000)+scheduleOrThrow()+retry:2 and CalendarTab has isError/refetch/Retry.

DEFERRED — morning browser check: throttle/kill /api/activity/schedule (or force scheduler_active=false), confirm CalendarTab shows the error banner + a working Retry, not a blank calendar. Deterministic proxy DONE: request now carries AbortSignal.timeout(15000); CalendarTab destructures isError+refetch and renders a role=alert banner with a Retry button (onClick=refetch()) directly under the toolbar (shows in day/week/month). Headless loop cannot run dev-browser.

DONE — npx tsc --noEmit holds at the branch's 713 pre-existing errors (set-diff vs pre-S10 baseline = ZERO new; the only two deltas are tsc's nondeterministic union-member ORDER in an untouched file's error text + main-layout's pathname error line-shifting 76->61 from the S10 ticker deletion — neither is a new error). AbortSignal.timeout typechecks (lib.dom). vitest 53 passed across 10 files (incl. 5 new S11). S11 is frontend-only; orchestrator pytest unaffected (last green at 2124).

userStories.title: NL2SQL tab revival + safety trims + entity-KG gate + token strip
userStories.description: (1) Three Databases tabs use raw fetch with no auth/baseUrl and 404 in split-origin deploys — migrate DatabaseQueryAnalytics.tsx:25-27, SemanticLayerBuilder.tsx:125,161, QueryTemplatesGrid.tsx:90,136 to apiClient (revives the Training tab instantly). (2) Honor the dialect field in generation. (3) On failure return a structured error — never an executable error-string SELECT. (4) Auth-gate the legacy entity-KG endpoints (api/knowledge_graph.py:84-559, currently unauthenticated cross-tenant) pending their PRD-165 deletion. (5) Strip the GitHub token from clone error messages (codegraph_service.py:489).
acceptanceCriteria: DEFERRED — morning browser check: open the Databases hub in a split-origin dev build (frontend origin != API origin) and click through all six sub-tabs (Query Analytics, Semantic Layer, Query Templates, Query Explorer, Training Examples, Add-Database); confirm each loads data with no 404. Deterministic proxy DONE: the 3 raw-fetch tabs now route every call through apiClient (baseUrl + Clerk/workspace headers injected) — DatabaseQueryAnalytics (real path components/context/, the story's knowledge/ path was stale), SemanticLayerBuilder, QueryTemplatesGrid. The other Databases sub-tabs already used apiClient (grep: zero raw fetch('/api') remains in components/knowledge|context except the unrelated KnowledgeGraphVisualizer). components/__tests__/databases-tabs-apiclient.test.ts (6): each migrated file imports apiClient AND carries no raw fetch('/api'). Headless loop cannot run dev-browser.

DONE — nl2sql_service.generate_sql on LLM failure now returns sql='' (NO executable SELECT) + metadata{success:False,error}; the old `SELECT 'Error generating SQL: ...' as error` would pass validation then EXECUTE, surfacing the error text as a fake result row. service.py query_database short-circuits a failed generation to a structured error {success:False, sql:None} instead of validating/executing the empty string. test_generate_sql_failure_returns_no_executable_sql + test_nl2sql_source_drops_error_string_select + test_service_short_circuits_generation_failure_with_no_sql.

DONE — the 7 unauthenticated entity-KG endpoints in api/knowledge_graph.py (list_entities, search_entities, get_entity_details, get_entity_graph, get_entity_documents, find_connection, get_entity_stats; lines 84-559) gained ctx=Depends(get_request_context_hybrid); the 3 graph/* endpoints already had it. test_entity_kg_endpoint_401_without_auth (param x7; valid query/path params supplied so the ONLY failure is auth -> 401, REQUIRE_AUTH forced on, get_db overridden, no DB) + test_every_knowledge_graph_route_carries_hybrid_gate (every route's flattened dependant carries the gate, so a future entity route is gated at birth). SQL left workspace-unfiltered pending PRD-165 deletion (story scope = gate only, not multi-tenant filter).

DONE — codegraph_service._clone_github_repo failure now redacts auth_token from git's error text (f'{token}@'->'***@' then bare token->'***') before raising; git echoes the authed clone URL https://<token>@github.com/... in its failure message, which the old `raise ValueError(... {e})` leaked. test_clone_error_strips_github_token: patched git.Repo.clone_from raises a token-bearing message -> the ValueError contains no token substring and still carries the safe (token-free) url.

DONE — cd orchestrator && python3 -m pytest -q: 2139 passed, 17 skipped, 1 xfailed (2124 + 15 new S12 backend tests). Frontend: npx tsc --noEmit holds at the branch's 713 PRE-EXISTING errors (set-diff vs pre-S12 baseline = ZERO new; all touched files clean) and npm run test green (59 passed across 11 files, incl. 6 new S12 tests). NOTES: (a) dialect sub-task (2) honored end-to-end — add_database_source gained one optional dialect kwarg (1 caller: the create endpoint, which now passes source.dialect) and stores it instead of the hardcoded postgresql # TODO, so a MySQL source no longer generates postgres SQL (test_add_database_source_accepts_dialect_param + _service_does_not_hardcode_postgres_dialect_on_create + _create_endpoint_forwards_dialect). (b) Sub-tasks (2)+(3) required api/database_knowledge.py + modules/nl2sql/{service.py, query/nl2sql_service.py}, omitted from the story files list (which named only the codegraph + knowledge_graph backend files) — obviously required, non-rippling. (c) The 713 tsc errors are platform-wide pre-existing tech-debt, NOT CI-gated (test.yml runs orchestrator pytest only).
